title: ALP–GGT coupling does not robustly improve cross-cycle femoral-neck BMD prediction
abstract: A fixed log alkaline-phosphatase by log GGT interaction trained in3056 NHANES2007–2008 adults aged40+ reduced weighted prediction MSE by only0.073% in3214 participants from2009–2010. Both target-only and source-target refit survey-PSU bootstrap intervals included no benefit. Source group-held-out MSE worsened; trimming extreme enzymes or omitting weights reversed the target gain. This negative test does not support robust incremental BMD information from this one product beyond flexible conventional measurements. It does not establish absence of biochemical bone information or clinical utility.
